literal_meaning: অর্থ এবং অর্থহীনতা (wealth and its opposite or ruin)
figurative_meaning_en: Money is the root of all ruin
similar_in_english: Money is the root of all evil
example_sentences_in_bangla: অর্থমনর্থম্, এই লোকটি ধনী হয়ে পরিবারের সব নষ্ট করে ফেলেছে।
জীবনে অর্থমনর্থম্ সত্যি, অর্থের লোভে অনেকে পথভ্রষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: Money is the root of all ruin; this man destroyed his family after becoming wealthy.
Life truly embodies 'money is the root of all evil,' as greed for wealth leads many astray.
note: Derived from Sanskrit 'arthamanartham,' emphasizing the dual nature of wealth in Bengali proverbial wisdom.
